integrity: Analytic proof with exact finite algebraic certificates and a standalone diagnostic checker. Self-review only, without independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to integrable integer-valued distributions with log-concave survival probabilities and adjacent mass dominance at an integer below the mean; not a classification for arbitrary local ratios. Literature-priority review is qualified because later source sections and some older sources were not fully accessible. Numerical tests are not a proof of the infinite theorem.
title: The plastic-constant sharp mean-tail bound for discrete IFR laws with adjacent mass dominance
